Name: Statue Of Anglers Sorrow
Author: keithmfrench
Description:
This mod adds a statue that can be bought from Krobus for $1,000,000.  (It was $5,000,000, but I realized that may have been too high)
Why so much, because I didn't want it to be a way to make money.
Each morning it will give you a random fish. (currently does not work with modded fish, may add some if people like this)
This includes the legendry fish.

Why is it called Anglers Sorrow?
Anglers enjoy fishing and this removes the need to fish.

Also uploaded a version of the statue that does not include the legendary fish but only cost $500,000.
Only install one version.

Need SMAPI, Json Assets, and Producer Framework Mod

You can change the price to whatever you want by editing: Statue of Anglers Sorrow\[JA] Statue of Anglers Sorrow\BigCraftables\Statue Of Anglers Sorrow\big-craftable.json

This mod is also compatible with eorrl's, Junimo Statue mod. You can download the optional files for whichever statues you're using, and unzip directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder. These statues can then be customized to any of the colour options above, using either the config file or spacechase0's Generic Mod Config Menu. To get the option files go to eorrl mod page: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8867?tab=description]Junimo Statues[/url]
